description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in the specified region.

description.zh:
数据库名称，限制如下：
- 只能包含字母，数字和下划线。
- 必须以字母开头。
- 长度不能超过63个字符.
description.en:
The name of the database. The following restrictions apply:

*   Contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_).
*   Must start with a letter.
*   Up to 63 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb list-database-extensions --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --database-name test01 --region cn-hangzhou
